newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian company profits fall in March qtr.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian company profits fall in March qtr.

text.p: Pre-tax profits of Australian companies with more than 30 employees fell 3.4 percent in the March quarter to A$11.491 billion from A$11.899 billion (revised from A$12.024 billion) in the December quarter, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
This compares with A$11.712 billion a year earlier.
Figures are seasonally-adjusted and before interest and depreciation.
Analysts had forecasts a median fall of around 2.0 percent for the March quarter.

The bureau said earnings before income tax, interest and depreciation were down 1.9 percent on the year.
It said there were revisions to the December quarter and minor revisions to the previous five quarters.
